integrity: Analytical proof and standalone numerical cross-check supplied; self-review only, not independent validation or publication certification.
scientific_limitations: Independent exponential killing, symmetric two-velocity continuous-time telegraph motion. The underlying endpoint/killing-time joint law and boundary ballistic component appear in Orsingher--Marchione arXiv:2610.15094v1. The added structural assertion is a finite compound-Poisson posterior factorization and distance-indexed convolution semigroup. Only a continuous regular-conditional version is asserted at a single specified endpoint; general velocity-jump processes are not covered. A potentially implicit equivalent factorization in earlier telegraph resolvent literature remains an originality risk.
title: Conditional compound-Poisson structure of killed telegraph travel time
